ud5.8:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Rājagaha, in Bamboo Wood, at the Squirrels’ Feeding Place.
ud5.8:1.3: Then at that time venerable Ānanda on the Observance day, having dressed in the morning time, after picking up his bowl and robe, entered Rājagaha for alms.
ud5.8:2.1: Devadatta saw venerable Ānanda walking for alms in Rājagaha,
ud5.8:2.2: and after seeing (him), he went to venerable Ānanda, and after going, he said this to venerable Ānanda:
ud5.8:2.3: “From today forward, friend Ānanda, apart from the Fortunate One, apart from the Community of monks, I will hold the Observance and perform [Legal] Acts of the Community.”
ud5.8:3.1: Then venerable Ānanda, after walking for alms in Rājagaha, while returning from the alms-round after the meal, went to the Fortunate One, and after going and worshipping the Fortunate One, he sat down on one side.
ud5.8:3.2: While sat on one side venerable Ānanda said this to the Fortunate One:
ud5.8:4.1: “Here I, reverend Sir, having dressed in the morning time, after picking up my bowl and robe, entered Rājagaha for alms.
ud5.8:4.2: Devadatta saw me, reverend Sir, walking for alms in Rājagaha,
ud5.8:4.3: and after seeing (me), he came to me, and after coming, he said this to me:
ud5.8:4.4: ‘From today forward, friend Ānanda, apart from the Fortunate One, apart from the Community of monks, I will hold the Observance and perform [Legal] Acts of the Community.’
ud5.8:4.5: Today, reverend Sir, Devadatta will split the Order, and will hold the Observance and perform [Legal] Acts of the Community (apart).”
ud5.8:5.1: Then the Fortunate One, having understood the significance of it, on that occasion uttered this exalted utterance:
ud5.8:6.1: “Done with ease by the good is good,
ud5.8:6.2: ~ good by the bad is done (only) with difficulty,
ud5.8:6.3: Bad by the bad is done with ease,
ud5.8:6.4: ~ bad by the Noble Ones is done (only) with difficulty.”
